steps.name: 2 years ago - above
steps.objective: Travel through the compartments of Asgard and check out the memories hidden in the stone tower.

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: Iris… Don't come... You can't come... !

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Ah! Iris, look at the sky over there! It's Genepe!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Genepe… !

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: The Demon King's goal is the powerful <power> hidden in the Der race's bloodline...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: !! The fact that the Demon King is currently staying in Yggdrasil...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: … Are you calling Iris?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: … … … Heh, he's a demon lord or something, but what he does is trivial, right?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: … … … Hmm.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Then, Genefe, the reason you are being held captive by the Demon Lord is...

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: … Ahhh… too… It’s so painful… please… Help me... !

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: No… no… You can't come... Ahhh!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Blood… blood?!… I can't believe it...

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Laugh… you. It looks so painful... Ugh.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Yes, you have to make up your mind. Muwen!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text:
… … … … … I can't forgive you.
Wait, Genefe! I will definitely save you... !!

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: Ah… No Iris. Run away. please… .

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: … disappeared.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: A boy from the Der tribe... It looks like they used their last strength to warn us.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text:
… … … … … … … … … 
Muwen… Won't you please come back from here?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Huh? What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: This is my fight. Muwen is… and… Other people too... . There is no longer a need to join in a dangerous fight... .

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Do… Don't talk nonsense Iris! We've been together this far!

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Hamo. There is no need to worry about that now, Kai. Suddenly, your fight is like my fight. It would be difficult to fight against the Demon King without Muwen's power, right?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Well then! Moreover, Iris is… … .

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Without me, everything happens haphazardly, I oversleep, I'm a bitch, I'm tone deaf, I can't even cook... Oh wow, is this really disqualification from being a member of society? How could I leave this behind! Ahem!

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Muwen is really acting like a big sister~~

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text:
Eh… Disqualification as a member of society... 
Now, wait a minute! Why are Bacchini and Munchini in there?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Hehe, well, the way he was dancing when I first met him was really...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Ka… Kazno~~~~

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (Dancing…?)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: … Hehe…

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Ah, Mr. Levy laughed. It’s been a while since I last saw you~

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: A sinful man...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Iris, among the people who came here with us… There is no one who will fall into a fight with the devil.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Yes, there is no fool who would miss this big event, which must only happen once in a lifetime.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Levy, Kazno…

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Don't waste my time on trivial matters. Even while this is going on, that girl named Guenephe is probably suffering, right?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text:
… !! Yes, that's right.
Okay, I won't say any more.
Thank you so much, everyone.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text:
… then… Let's go! To Yggdrasil! 
Let’s defeat the devil!

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Okay. Before that… I think it would be best to look for Siam, who broke up with me, first.

lines.speaker: 무웬&조에
lines.text: Yes!!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Heh! Because I'm always a late child.

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: In the end… It's coming... Are you saying you won't?

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: … … … … That's how it should be. Because Iris is nice. Hehehe…

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text:
Hehehe… 
It's been long, I've finally made it this far.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text:
If you've come this far, it's over. It's as if that girl was in my hands.
I don't need a doll like you anymore.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: … No, wait.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: To ensure that everything ends, you must bring about complete [despair] and break the will to resist.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text:
… Yes.
Iris, [Genefe], the only surviving compatriot who was desperately looking for that child... .

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Actually, it is a living, breathing [doll] that I created using the genes of Iris, but it is just a shell without intelligence or heart... If you teach me that... .

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: … At that time, Iris will become completely despairing.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: … joy. Well, until then, I guess I'll have to hold off on disposing of this doll.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주의 영상
lines.text:
… … … this… what… What is this... !!
If you defeat the devil, everyone becomes happy... Wasn't it?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주의 영상
lines.text:
Iris delivers the final blow to the Demon King, and while the two are talking about something, 
A huge and beautiful bird appears in the air... 
The moment it landed on the devil's shoulder, the situation changed.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주의 영상
lines.text:
The power of the Demon King, who was evil but pure darkness itself, became <crooked>
 and attacked us with a ferocious power that was incomparable to before...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주의 영상
lines.text:
What I saw before I lost consciousness was 
powerful beings appearing one by one from thin air... .
I felt every single one had a power comparable to that of the Demon King..

lines.speaker: 흑월공주의 영상
lines.text:
… In the beginning… Did you know that things would turn out like this?
IrisYou knew that what you were doing would ultimately ruin the world... Were you trying to stop it?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주의 영상
lines.text:
Then why… I was the only one who embraced it... 
… … … … I don't know… .

lines.speaker: 흑월공주의 영상
lines.text:
One thing is clear... 
 All… Everything… Iris… It's because... !
Kuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu its herself before its melodrama !
Keuuuu… I don't forgive... 
Never! I will not forgive you!!!

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text:
… … … 
The devil was defeated… The moment I thought that, 
 Agashuras from all over the world started laughing right in my ears... I had that feeling.

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text: The Demon King opened his eyes again... A ‘uglyness’ that never existed before… ‘Madness’ and… Intense ‘laughter’… It's already something different from the Demon King before... I met you once somewhere... A gaze as if looking at an insect... ah… I don't know…

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text:
The moment the Demon King lost his power because of me, everything changed.
Suddenly the sky was torn apart... Tearing the darkness, darkness seeps in again...

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text:
Shining beings that appear here and there... 
Every single one is a devil... No, beings close to ‘gods’…

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text:
The moment the demon king of our world lost his power... The wall that blocked Gndia from the outside world has disappeared, and everything in the darkness outside has a greedy gaze... I started looking at our world.
Ah… .

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text:
… … Are 
Muwen and Zoe okay? Princess Black Moon... I guess it will be okay since Levy protected me... .

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text:
But instead, Master Levy died... .
Genefe… Genepe too... 
And… Kazno…

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text:
… 
Kazno is… are you okay… 
Yes… okay… … Obviously at the end...

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text: Because he killed me.

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text: … … me… Things are going to get weird, I think... … .

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text:
Tears… ?
Ah… no… I, I, shouldn't cry.
I have the right to pity myself... None.
What I did… You have to take responsibility...

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text:
… ah… But how… what… ?
Grandma… Maybe I like it?

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text: … who… please… …

lines.speaker: 이리스의 영상
lines.text: Help me... …

steps.name: 2 years ago - below
steps.objective: Check out the memorial hidden in Hell's Door's stone tower.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text:
Agashura. 
Agash is an exile from another world. A being who commits a great sin is exiled from his own world to Gendia and has to live as a 'monster'.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: In other words, our [evilness] is not natural... this world is forcing us to live as monsters... as [darkness].

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: ...Iris is a good kid.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: The innate power that flows in the blood of the Der people... . It was given to the Der people to defeat Agashura. But their kind nature made them no match for the Agashuras.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: With her grandmother and ... dying, Iris is left alone for the last time... . All of the fates bestowed on the Der people began to come together in one girl named Iris.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: I went on a trip carrying such a heavy burden and experienced many happy and sad things... The kid wasn't crooked. He was truly a good kid.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: I didn't hate this sweet kid who cried, got angry easily, and was selfish, but decided to accept his cruel fate and save the world.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: … But my name is Kazno.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: I am the eldest brother of brothers who come from different hometowns but are bound together by a mean fate. One of the leaders of the Agashuras.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: The controller of destiny that binds us... In order to overcome the [Demon King], I went along with Choen Palm's plan... Iris betrayed!

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: In all of Agashura's actions, [evil] must be at the root... If this is not the case, the person responsible will be subject to punishment that can even lead to extinction in severe cases.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text:
Agashura is a being that is dark, evil, and destined to finally be destroyed by the hand of light.
Therefore, if I act evil, it becomes a natural thing that this world supports.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: So betraying Iris is... It was so easy. The irony of taking advantage of fate in order to escape it... It's funny.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: Now that the goal has been achieved... true disillusionment comes.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text:
...Iris survived.
A kid named Siam from another world.
He didn't hesitate for a moment on my suggestion.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text:
[Agasura's Contract] was concluded, and he saved Iris from death.
At that time, I also felt a little comforted.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: But now, this intense and dark feeling is reaching me from beyond Yggdrasil. This… The despair of Iris.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: Since I don't have the courage to face her, I try to take a gamble with little chance of winning.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text:
...I see fragments of light falling from Asgard to the ground.
That's a memorial. A memorial is a stone that engraves strong emotions, memories, and wishes onto the body.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: What appears to be her tears is not just my sentiment.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: A very faint and faint hope falls on the earth... a very faint... hope.

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text:
In this world, I am free now.
So now... Where should I go?

lines.speaker: 카즈노의 영상
lines.text: Where… …

steps.name: to the sky
steps.objective: After talking with Jade at the “Top of Collapse Tower”, go to “Vanaheim”.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Siam was waiting at the top of the tower instead of Jade)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: There is no time for a long story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Siam raises his staff and points to an island floating beyond the clouds.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: We are ready to send you there. Be prepared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s choose.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: As part of the curse received in the fight against the Demon King, I am unable to return to the normal world... but this place is no longer a 'normal dimension'.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Vanaheim... This world, which was initially separated from the original world and was incomplete, is slowly collapsing.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: As the Bird of Flame and the people from the outside world came in after it, the power of the old barrier was weakened.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: That's why I came to this place and heard about the situation from a wizard named Jade.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: ...After I let you go, I plan to prevent this place from collapsing like this.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Don't let the dark power that fills this place overflow and contaminate countless dimensions.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: The other half of this little world, I guess.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: A whirlpool containing a storm, a powerful barrier protecting the island, and an island sitting on top of it...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: It all feels like the same power that Iris had.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Perhaps what is above is the legacy left behind by the Der people.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: To find out what it is, see it with your own eyes.

choices.text: 3. Is the Flame Bird over there too?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Absolutely. Standing here, I can clearly feel its presence from beyond the sky.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: But now I am very weak. I won't be able to resist you now.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Perhaps its true identity is...

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: ...Now, let's stop making hasty conclusions.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Jade Or Felix. He's a good talent. If you work hard, you will become a great wizard.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Now I have gone to prepare what I asked for. Materials and people.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: If he does well, Vanaheim will not disappear and the safety of other dimensions will be preserved.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Take this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Siam hands over a ring.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: A ring containing the power of space-time magic. With this, you can reach the place beyond the magical vortex.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Also, the magical power of this ring is connected to me.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: So you can receive my magic power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have an unknown feeling in the ring.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: ...Okay, then I need to prepare magic to maintain this world.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: May you keep your pride.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Siam jumped off the tower with a light gesture and left.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (After completing the quest, put on the ring and look at the skill window.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I felt a little dizzy, but before I knew it, I was standing in the middle of the forest.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Midnight forest. But not dark.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It seems like the night hanging over this place will never go away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That impression is the same as on the ground, but you see a completely different landscape than on the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The beautiful night sky is full of stars, and the lake illuminated by the light shines silver. Was this what the earth looked like before it was polluted by darkness?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But I feel a sense of emptiness as if it will disappear at any moment.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The silence in the forest does not feel corrupted darkness or malice, but it feels fleeting and uneasy.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Somehow this place reminds me of the girl I met in Zenadia.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...let's explore the surroundings.)

steps.name: last guardian
steps.objective: Explore [Banaheim]. A certain connection awaits at the end of [Banaheim].

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Deep in the forest, a woman is standing next to a huge tree.)

lines.speaker: 여인
lines.text: ...Something unbelievable happened...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This is the girl from the video seen at the stone pagoda. She's a little older, but she's clear.)

lines.speaker: 여인
lines.text: As expected, the barrier of Vanaheim... was destroyed?

lines.speaker: 여인
lines.text: This person... No, I don't feel that kind of evil energy from this person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The woman is lost in thought and looks towards us as if startled.)

lines.speaker: 여인
lines.text: No, I'm sorry. I said to myself.

lines.speaker: 여인
lines.text: I don't know how long it's been since I've had a real customer.

lines.speaker: 여인
lines.text: Traveler, welcome to Vanaheim. My name is Der, the last inhabitant of this land.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Why do you look surprised, traveler? Is there some story?

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Come on, come closer... I want to hear your story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I met Der.)

steps.name: Altar of Transcendence
steps.objective: Obtain <Flower Seal><Moon Seal> from the "Flower Path" and "Moon Path" and then go to the "Altar of Transcendence" in the "Dream Path."

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: ...this...
(As he tries to move forward, an invisible force pushes him away.)

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: Someone has created a barrier to prevent anyone from moving forward.

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: This form... no way...
(Siam shakes his head and says.)

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: I don't know who or why is blocking your path, but this cannot be broken through by force.

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: In order to lift this barrier... you will need the help of Princess Black Moon.

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: The power that the Black Moon Clan has had for generations... This barrier is made to react to that.

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: (Rather than blocking the way forward...)

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: (Are you guiding me...)

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: Come on, hurry up, Aoichiro!
(Let’s go see Princess Black Moon.)

steps.name: sad heart
steps.objective: In "Cherry Lake Street 4", you meet Princess Black Moon and ask for help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Princess Black Moon is looking at the surface of the lake.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Wizard, are you watching? Reveal yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (An illusion of Siam appears.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: There is a barrier that only I can break, so I need help?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: It's a strange story. Vanaheim? A part of Ziendia that was sealed in ancient times? Why is there something related to me in such a corner of land?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Does what's inside the barrier have something to do with me? Yeah... I guess so?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: you would know What awaits there?

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: ......Perhaps the princess's guess is correct.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Hmph...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: The 'bird of flame' you spoke of... Yes, I saw that too in the fight against the Demon King.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: And now I know its identity...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...The woman I met in Valhalla had really cold eyes.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I knew that the first time we met at Aoichi and the years we spent together were all a lie.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: The smiles that made me laugh awkwardly at my complaints, the times Ame and the three of us played and giggled, and the lullabies that were sung softly like my late mother... all of them.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: It was all... a lie.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I'm not going.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I can't forgive her, but I don't want to help hurt her.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: %s, I'm sorry to say this when you've helped me a lot...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...I don't want anything to do with her anymore.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Go back.

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly, the Shadow Ninja King and the Tengu appear and guard her.)

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: ...I don't think there's any point in persuading me any further.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I do?)

choices.text: 1. Try to persuade him a little more.

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: Didn't you hear what the princess said? The audience ends here. How cruel! Like?

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: I'm truly sorry, but if I disturb the princess's heart any further, I will have no choice but to carry out my duties as a vassal...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He's smiling as if he's embarrassed, but today's Ninja King seems a little serious...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s choose.)

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: Oh my... I can't help it. Be prepared!

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: Hey, I lived. I hate fights I can't win. But the opportunities to make jokes have diminished?!

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: sullen...

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: [Hmm, honey, let me give you some advice.]

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You can hear the Tengu's voice in your head.)

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: [The thing inside that barrier is definitely a flame chick.]

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: [The chick was probably already in a state of complete disrepair before it arrived there.]

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: [When I looked at the land with my mind's eye, I saw fragments of the chick's soul scattered here and there.]

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: [Could it be that a part of the bleeding soul resides in the stone you call Memorium? A stone like that is called a memorial, right?]

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: [If we look for it, maybe there will be a clue that can change the princess's heart?]

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: [The princess says that, but I know. There were never only lies in that chick’s heart.]

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: [Haha, I agree with you. If not, this old man would have baked Choen Palm a long time ago, right?]

lines.speaker: 텐구
lines.text: [...This guy is now joining the electric band?! He’s a comedic character, so he’s very talented, right? Who is Yeongtaeng?!]

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Tengu started stepping on the Ninja King...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Following Tengu’s words, I decided to look for Choen Palm’s memorial.)

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: Whoa! As expected, he is the main character. Even for me who fights sincerely, isn’t this a bit too much? -Rather, the real reason is that Tengu helped us half-heartedly!

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: But today, I am a loyal subject who sacrifices his life for the princess, and I have no intention of backing down from here!

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: (Hehe, I look really cool today, I’m going to show off all the elegant poses I’ve prepared so far!)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Tsukikage.

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: Old, princess! Princess Tsukikage is here!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: It's noisy.

lines.speaker: 그림자 닌자왕
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Ninja King was crushed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The tengu rolled the crushed Ninja King to the side and approached.)

steps.name: Memories of an Exile
steps.objective: Defeat monsters in all areas of Vanaheim and obtain all <Choenfarm's Memorial>. And it is delivered to Princess Black Moon in “Cherry Tree Lake 4”.

lines.text: (Princess Black Moon silently accepted the memorial handed to her.)
(The memorial begins to glow faintly in her hand with her eyes closed.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: This can't be...
(Princess Black Moon's complexion turns pale.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: She... Choen Palm... didn't betray me.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Choen's despairing soul was burning itself all along.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: How could you do something so cruel...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: This memorial... thank you for bringing it to me.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I won't leave her alone in this madness any longer.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Let’s go together to Vanaheim.
(I decided to go to the Altar of Transcendence with Princess Black Moon.)

steps.name: What kind of play?
steps.objective: After collecting all <Choenpam's Memorial>, deliver it to Princess Black Moon in "Cherry Tree Lake 4".

lines.text: (I am in the black darkness. My body is heavy. It feels like I have become a water bag...)
(Looking into memories from someone’s perspective.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Uh...yeah....

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Who...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Surprisingly, the girl, who is only a character in my memory, seems to feel my presence.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But somehow he doesn't seem to have a clear mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can feel terrible pain lurking beyond her hazy mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The whole side of my head is burning, and something cold and wet is running down the back of my head...)
Baby... baby...!

lines.speaker: 여인
lines.text: Ah! You've come to your senses... I'm glad, I'm glad...

lines.speaker: 여인
lines.text: Oh my...who would do this to our beautiful baby...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: People...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: People... They say Choen Palm can't ascend to the sky because of me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The woman hugs the girl without saying anything.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The girl's consciousness fades away...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Time seems to have passed.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (...I feel like someone is around.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (Is it an illusion...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Should I ask the girl a question?)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (I... I'm just me.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (It has no name... It shouldn't have a name.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (Because my very existence is a ‘sin’...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (Because of me, Choen Palm cannot ascend to heaven.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (Choen Palm is the shaman of purification.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (Someday, you will become the bride of heaven.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (My older sister...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (It's written in the temple.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (For Choen Palm to become the bride of heaven, she must shed all human grime and become pure.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (For that purpose, Choen Palm separated the dirt from himself when he was born and was born separately.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (That's me...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (So, my very existence is a sin.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (When you turn seventeen, Choen Palm will undergo a purification ritual.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (If Choen Palm, who has become the bride of heaven, burns me, all the sins in the world will also be burned.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (Then all people will become good and kind beings and live happily next to Heaven...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (I'm having strange thoughts today.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (It's okay...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (If Choen Palm makes everyone happy because of me...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (If mom can be happy...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: (It's okay...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The girl began to fall asleep.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (With the feeling of falling, I came out of the memory of Memorial.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Why...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As before, it is in the girl's consciousness...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Why...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Another beautifully dressed girl collapses before her eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Although it is a little younger than the current one, it is the same as Choen Palm.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She is shaking and looking up at the girl.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Heavenly Bride...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Wasn't it supposed to save the world?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: But why... why did you do this to your mother...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The girl is holding something black in her arms.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It looks like a lump of charred charcoal...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: I'm your mother too...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Why...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Why did you do this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choen Palm answers with a trembling expression and an unpleasant expression.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Who is whose mother, you filthy thing?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: It's not enough to have given birth to something like you; the sin of trying to make it escape is too much!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Out of my special kindness, I 'purified' this body with the sacred flame... but you are like a bug and don't even know the grace!

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Holy flame...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The girl looks back the way she came.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A large pile of firewood is burning black and sending out cold smoke.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: To me, it just looks like a wood fire...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: If the sacred flame is like this...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: What kind of ‘salvation’ is written in the temple?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: ...Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (When the girl turned around, Choen Palm stabbed the girl with a knife...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But the girl doesn't seem to feel anything.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Monster... monster...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: ...Answer me. Heavenly Bride. How are our sins purified?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: How do people become happy?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: That...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: How do I know that!!!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: In order to show that humans follow God's teachings and do not disobey them, people have served the Heavenly Bride from generation to generation!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: If you live righteously according to the precepts of the temple, perhaps God will mercifully take away things like you.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Well, don't sin anymore. Repentance... Repent and follow Jeonghwa's fate!

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: From generation to generation...?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Are you saying there was a heavenly bride other than Choen Palm?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...? okay. I am the 72nd Bride of Heaven.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: 72 units...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Haha... okay... I understand.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Salvation is human imagination, heavenly bride is a false symbol. This pathetic story has been told 72 times. Is this the story?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: What... what?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: For that reason, 72 twins had their names taken away, were kept in captivity, and were burned when they turned seventeen...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: It was all... a lie.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ?! Let it go, let it go! Where are you touching the body, you cruel...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The girl grabs Choen Palm by the neck with one hand and lifts it into the air.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: This is what a shrine maiden says, and that her two daughters will save the world...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: If I had believed until the end, it wouldn't have ended up like this, Mom...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A spark erupts from the girl's hand and burns Choen Palm's face.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Evil! Hot, hot! Wow!!!

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Yes... you are not the bride of heaven or the shaman of purification.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: I guess the prophecy was a little wrong.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Wow!!! Save me, save me!!! Hot, hot, hot!!!!

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Because you’re my sister, I won’t let you die.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Let it burn...until the world ends.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The girl throws Choen Palm's burning body to the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choen Palm, which was instantly charred, still screams and struggles without dying...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Yeah. Since you won't need it anymore, that name... I'll take it.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: It's been my lifelong wish, to have a name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The girl who was Choen Palm now cries with animal-like screams instead of words...)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...That was probably my name from the beginning. This is.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Hello, my twin sister. I will do my job properly as the ‘shaman of purification’.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: The sister I saw from afar was beautiful, sacred, and I really loved her.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...But it suits you better now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The girl... no, Choen Palm raises her hand and everything around begins to burn.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choen Palm slowly walks out and the memory of the memorial begins to end...)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Hahaha..... Ahhahaha....

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choen Palm's sad laughter fades away...)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: People...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Red wilderness all the way to the horizon. A haze full of heat blooms dizzyingly)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The scorching heat seems to come from the earth, not the sky... no, from her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The stone at my feet has become soft from the heat.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (In an unrealistic landscape, an old man is sitting on a rock and reading a book.)

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: This is it, I finally met you, the shaman of purification.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...I'm glad to see you too, it's been 7 years since I met someone.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Ho, ho, ho... I see. That's how thorough the shaman was.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: This is because over the past sixty years, everything in the world has burned with a purifying fire.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Yes... as the saying goes, I left nothing behind me. It went around the world and burned it down completely.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: So, I have to ask you a question.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Hoo, what is it? I will answer what I can.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Are you heaven?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The old man who was looking at Choen Palm said this and scratched his cheek.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly, I feel a suffocating presence from the old man...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choen Palm used all the strength in his body to resist the urge to immediately kneel down and bow to the old man.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She glares at the old man with scary eyes...)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...Answer me. What have you done to me?

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Ho...? What do you want to say, shaman?

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Haven't you made your own choices in the life you were born with and lived until now?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Don't play with words!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Yes, on the day my sister burned my mother... the power opened its eyes and the anger did what it told me to do...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: It's my sin...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: But... what is this now? After traveling around the world for 60 years, everything in sight... Why? I never wanted that!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: No, for the first time, on that day, not even... I... didn't... want... to... kill... anyone!!!

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Yes... it's pitiful... but you did it.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: It was said to the temple, "The bride of heaven will purify the world, and all sins will be forgiven."

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Are your sins forgiven?

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: That's right. Your life was prepared for that from the beginning.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Are you ready...?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: What... are you talking nonsense?! Everyone has died, so what is the forgiveness of sins, what is happiness, what is the word of the temple?!!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Strange, why did everyone have to die? Why did you make me do this, why? why?! why!!!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The old man is silent for a moment after hearing Choenpham's screaming cry, and then begins to laugh.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The old man's laugh, with the corners of his mouth curved wide like a crescent moon and saying "Eeheehee", was the most terrifying thing Choen Palm had ever seen in his life...)

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: It's a fresh start. Shaman.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...What?

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text:
Now that we have purified the old, dirty, worn-out world, we must create a new world, right? 
It has always been like that.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...always... like that?

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: That’s right, no matter how well you cultivate the world, it will eventually rot and become dirty.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: After experiencing something like that a few times, I set up a rule to help me clean things up.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Now, if I create a new world using your blood and flesh as fertilizer, a new world will be born where your corpse is worshiped as the Earth Mother.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: For a while, a paradise will be created on this earth.... As humans gain wisdom and become corrupt, the new world will gradually become the old world and face the end.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Watching the rise and fall of such a world may be surprising, but it's not boring! Would it be like a storybook where stories gush out like spring water?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choen Palm is devastated as he looks at the old man’s smile.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ............I can't believe it.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Heaven... it's nothing like that.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You are... crazy... crazy!!!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: No...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: I wasn't born for this!!!!!!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choen Palm's vision turns red, and a huge flame that seems to reach the sky erupts from its entire body.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The flames instantly fill the horizon, turning into a huge tsunami and washing over the old man.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Disappear!!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Roaring, heat, noise.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The flame slowly subsides, and the old man remains standing without a single wound.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The old man is holding Choen Palm's neck in one hand and something black and wriggling in the other.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Ugh... Ugh....

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Hoho... I thought it would be like this. It looks like the shaman has no intention of becoming my bride.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: It's okay. I am a merciful one, and I will grant any wish of creation.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Actually, what use is a bride to God? Here... let's use this thing that has received your 'curse' as a seedbed to grow life.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choen Palm thinks he saw somewhere a black thing squeaking next to him, held in the old man's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The mind slowly fades into darkness.)

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Then... for the sake of the new world, let's get rid of all the old beings.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: There's a place that's perfect for a shaman.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: It's a world where even the gods have fled because absurd chaos and dark forces have overtaken the world.

lines.speaker: 노인
lines.text: Perhaps destruction is imminent, and living as a slave to the darkness won't be a very comfortable life... Well, I can't do that because I don't need 'boring' beings like you in my new world. Goodbye!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As the old man's voice fades away, Choen Palm feels like he is being sucked somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: (Everything in the world was just a clown’s play for him.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: (My 'everything' was just for that...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (In his fading consciousness, Choenpam repeats one thought.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: (....nothing....)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: (Forgiveness... I can't...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Rage consumes her spirit completely, darkness takes her in...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The memory of the memorial has ended.)

steps.name: bird and moon
steps.objective: Meet Choen Palm at the "Altar of Transcendence" inside the "Dream Path".

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Is this the Altar of Transcendence?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Hmm, the scenery is nice, but despite the grand name, there is nothing there.

lines.speaker: 남자의 목소리
lines.text: This is a place where decorations have no meaning.

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: Kazno...?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Second, second!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (In the center of the altar, Kazno stands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Behind Kazno, Choen Palm is hanging in the air.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Chains that appear in the air are restraining her body.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choen Palm appears to be unconscious.)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: It's been a while, Princess Black Moon, the wizard, and... I met you in Arcadia.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: You look embarrassed. Is it strange that I'm here?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Yeah... it's a strange place to meet and chat...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's choose a question...)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Hmm, do you understand if it's to prevent her with the power of the Demon Lord from burning the world?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...With the power of the devil...?

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: As expected... was it she who appeared next to the Demon King at that time?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Yes, the flame bird that appeared at that time was Choen Palm right here.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...So, what does stopping Choen have to do with you being here?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Choen Palm had a reason to come here.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: This is the best place to remove the soul of the demon lord that bound her mind.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: That day, Choen Palm took advantage of the Demon King's weakness due to the fatal blow delivered by Iris and obtained the Demon King's body. The souls of the Der people that made up the Demon King's soul were scattered as soon as they were separated from the Demon King.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: With nothing seeming to stand in her way, she used her newfound powers to her heart's content, defeating the Iris group and pushing powerful beings from another dimension back into their world.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: He would never have dreamed that the 'doll' he created would disturb her.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...Genepe...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Genefe was a ‘doll’ created by Choenpam to lure Iris and cause despair.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: However, Princess Black Moon and Siam, the two people must have seen it...

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: That child protected Iris from Choenpam's attack... and disappeared.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Yeah. I was surprised at that time too.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Since the Der people resembled Iris so much, did they not contain the souls of the Der people who wandered the world?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Anyway, that wasn't the only 'miracle' that Genepe achieved.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Many of the demon king's souls, which should have been heartlessly scattered in the air, gathered together around Genepe's 'soul' and became embedded in Choenpham's spirit.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Choenpam was no longer able to properly use the power of the Demon King that he had acquired for so long. At least a part of it once constituted the soul of the Demon King, so 'they' drove Choenpham's spirit to the brink of destruction.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: That's why Choenpam had to come to this place.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: I said it a little while ago. ‘Decoration has no meaning’ in this place.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: This place was literally the ‘altar’ where the Der tribe sacrificed their souls to give birth to the Demon King.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Choenpham thought that in this place, it would be possible to separate the souls of the Der tribe that had fused with his own spirit. It actually happened that way.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: However, you probably didn't think that you would catch me.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...Why?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: You... are Agashura?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...Really, you and Choen have been deceiving me well all this time.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...I heard that Agashura has three leaders.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Kazno Are you one of those three?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: ...Hmm, you've studied thoroughly, Princess Black Moon.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Don't play around.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Are you of the same race? Didn't we work together from the beginning in the fight against the Demon King?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: You must have been planning to betray Iris, whom you loved so much, from the beginning, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Kazno, who had been talking in a light manner, shuts up for the first time.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...Hmph!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Why are you now hostile to Choen?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: ...Okay. It was like that. What we want is to break free from the bonds that bind us.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Freedom! I wanted to give freedom to my people who were caught up in fate!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Even if it's false...

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: (It was false...?)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: But Choen Palm had no intention of stopping there.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: What she wanted was to fill the whole world with flames.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Yes, as if I wanted to recreate the horrors of Megido, a city of flames deep in the demon world, in this world...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...what...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Do you think it would have been possible to pass on the power of the Demon King to her?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: It can't be! Choen, no, Choen never does anything like that. I can't do that!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Have you ever had a chance to understand more about her? princess.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Well... first of all, I agree. Choen Palm was a cruel woman to her enemies, but she wasn't that crazy.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Then why...!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: No way....

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Kazno nods)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: What was it like when you met her in Valhalla? Tell me, princess. How did you feel? Did you feel betrayed?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: .....Yes, I thought I was betrayed. I felt so resentful.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: But on the other hand...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: (This is not Choen, it can’t be Choen...!)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I thought it was a vain emotion born from a weak heart...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: ...So? What do you think now?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: ...If you fall into the abyss, you will become the abyss itself.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Couldn't the seed of flame within her have been someone's last entertainment?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ....I can't do that....

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: ...That's the thing, how many of those who are called sinners in the world had the opportunity to choose?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: It's not that special for fate to be particularly cruel and even evil to someone...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: It's too much...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Yeah, that's too much.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: But I can't help but ask.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Answer me, Princess Black Moon.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: That guy knows. I came this far in hopes of finding Iris.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: But Princess Black Moon, your goal is not her, but this woman here.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: What do you plan to do now? What do you want to do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Princess Black Moon paused for a moment, but answered immediately without hesitation.)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...I'm going to save you.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: I came here to save Choen. We will return to Aoichi together.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Haha... I thought you would say that too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A chuckle is heard from behind Kazno scratching his head.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Really, this girl is still the same.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Choen!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Have you come to your senses?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Choen... Come back with me.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Let’s go back to Aoichi together. huh...?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: That's stupid... don't talk nonsense.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Choen...?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You're still talking in a daze...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: The friendly Choen the princess knew never existed in the first place.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: What is in front of the princess is the dawn of enlightenment, a person who burns down hypocrisy and wrongdoing for a new era, and lives to turn everything into nothingness.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Although we ultimately failed thanks to this traitor...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Heh... you're a traitor...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Hmm... time is on my side anyway, I will definitely accomplish my mission.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: No...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: No, that's not what you said, Choen.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: The one who brought you here is still playing with your fate!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: What... are you talking about...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Please... open your eyes, Choen, don't give in to the hatred in your heart!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Well... what are you talking about...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Choen!!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Shut up, shut up, shut up!!! It's loud!!! Come closer, I'll burn you right away!!!

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Choen!!! please!!!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: ───Self. Until here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Kazno, who had been sitting still, took a step forward.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly, a strong energy begins to emanate from Kazno.)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Choen PalmMiss is saying this, but Princess Black Moon has no intention of backing down.

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: ...Kazno... What are you trying to say?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: No, I've said enough.

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: No! Kazno!!!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly, the sword drawn by Kazno is stuck in Princess Black Moon's chest.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Princess Black Moon becomes stiff and collapses.)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Risk factors should be removed immediately.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Kazno, what have you done...?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: I'm thinking, "I'm going to save you from here," but there's nothing I can do about it.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Because I don't want to see the world destroyed because of you.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You... you...!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Why do you do that? You have a bad complexion. It's not that important, is it?

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: %s, the bleeding is unusual. If we leave it like this, something big will happen...!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (We must save the Black Moon Princess!)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But Kazno stands in the way!)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Hey, didn't you just hear what I said? He's a bit of a brainiac.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Then you can't... Shall we give it a try, buddy?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (In an instant, the image of Kazno became transparent in the air, and the imposing figure of Agashura appeared!)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Hmm, I guess I'll have to stop here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Kazno leaps back quickly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think the fight ends here....)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Hey, girl. You seem to be in a bad mood, huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choenpam is sweating and suffering.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She grits her teeth and glares at Kazno.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You... this... guy...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Second... N...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Princess Black Moon makes a weak voice.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She is lying in a puddle of her own blood...)

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Turn around... let's go...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Cherry tree... lake... by the side...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...Princess Black Moon...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Ah...pa...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Help... give me... choen...

lines.speaker: 흑월공주
lines.text: Second...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Princess Black Moon...?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Oh my... is he dead? I guess I lost too much blood.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Too bad.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: You...you!!! Kazno!!!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Why are you angry, Choen Palm? It's just that an unrelated girl died.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Shut up... Shut up...!!!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Wasn’t it meant to purify the world by burning it and turning everything into nothingness?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: A human being destined to die just died. It's nothing special.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Shut up... I...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: I don't want that!!!

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Ahhh... ahhh!!!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something is jumping out of Choenpam.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Although it is not visible to the eye, something that surrounded her body in several layers disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's as if the chains that bound her body are breaking.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Black moon...

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Silly girl... you don't have to do this.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: I'm disqualified from being a bodyguard like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The pattern on Choenpam's forehead heats up and her body begins to glow)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...My "wish" is... for the Black Moon Princess to come back to life.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Darkness. I will give you my life, the price of your wish. Take it away.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: I will decide the price that Princess Black Moon will pay... I will take her 'memory' of me.

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: (She decides the price of 'Agasura's wish' herself? ...Did she break some of Agashura's rules when she became the 'Demon King'?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choenpam’s body turns white.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Kazno. This damn human. You don't want to say thank you, do you?

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: I don't know what I'm planning to do since I'm forcing a life that's already dead, but I'll give it a try...

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: (What... When he signed a contract with me, his life...)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Princess Black Moon....

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...I think what I really wanted... has already come true thanks to the princess.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: Forget about me and live happily.

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...Can we meet again?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For a moment, Choenpham's body shines so brightly that he can't open his eyes.)

lines.speaker: 초엔 팜
lines.text: ...Hehehe... It was a fucking life.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The next moment, her appearance disappears.)

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: ...Choen Palm... It seems like he returned to his true self at the last moment.

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: Isn’t this what you wanted it to be like from the beginning, Kazno?

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: Did you want to save her?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Well... I guess I look like that kind of person.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Well, we've eliminated her, so we've achieved our goal.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Oh, I'll pass this on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something like a small piece of light rises from Kazno’s hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It shines weakly, floats through the air and approaches me.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (And then it gets closer, becomes transparent, and then disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something small and warm entered my chest...)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: It is a part of the soul fragment of the Der people that has been tormenting Choenpham.

lines.speaker: 사이암의 영상
lines.text: The soul of the Der people...?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: It seems like it has almost lost its power and will disappear soon, but it might have some use.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Okay then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Kazno has left.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Ah... welcome back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Der smiles and welcomes me.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But it feels strange...)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: I'm glad I can finally say goodbye.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: ...The power of darkness that has colored my body a while ago is getting stronger.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: When the barrier on this land was broken, my time started moving again.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: In the end, like all life in Njord and Vanaheim, it is destined to become a part of darkness.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: ...Before that happens, at least try to end it myself.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: If it becomes a dark being as it is now, it will become too much of a threat to the world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Der is silent for a moment, then hesitates a little before speaking.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: ...No matter how much I wandered through this world in my dreams, I was always alone.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: I was happy to meet you at the end of my lonely dream. thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The piece of light received from Kazno appeals to something in my heart.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: When we can part ways with a smile... let's say goodbye.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Hello, bye.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s choose.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: ...Why are you doing that?

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Even if you are there, nothing changes...

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: I... can't take it anymore.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: I don't want you to see me deteriorating, don't you know?

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Please... I can't finish this if I have you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She desperately appeals...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But I feel like I should never leave her behind.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: You... are so kind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A stream of darkness begins to climb Der’s body.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: But... that's stupid.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Why don't you know that your warm heart can become cruel?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Her appearance gradually changes.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: ...Ah... I can feel your soul, it's so... sweet...

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: ...What am I talking about now... Are you going to become my original sin?

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: If I don't kick you out while you're conscious...

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Come on, let's run away! Otherwise I'll kick you out!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Der is attacking!)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: I hope you can meet my descendants as you wish.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: But, don't take too many risks.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Heh... it would be meaningless to say this to you who came all the way to this place, right?

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: May the light, all good beings, and a little luck guard your path...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Der smiles softly and bids farewell.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He leaves the forest, leaving behind her waving hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel a bright, warm light swell and disappear behind my back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (At the same time, the piece of light received from Kazno disappeared from my heart.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The piece of light disappeared in an instant, as if screaming, as if a light had gone out, leaving a blank space in my heart.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I decided to leave the forest without looking back until the end.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: ...I've never seen a warrior like you.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Although I was once the teacher of the entire clan... I am no match for you.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Why aren't you listening to my request?

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: I changed like this just by stepping into the darkness a little bit.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: I never wanted to show myself like this... Why are you humiliating me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Der bites his lip.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly, a piece of light given by Kazno begins to flicker within the body.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: ...What about that light?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A large swollen piece of light separates from my body.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (And it gradually begins to take on the shape of a person.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: You... you... could it be...?

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: ...I've been looking for you for a long time...

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Ah... is this... a dream?

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Isn't it a dream?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The darkness clears and her appearance returns to normal.)

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Isn't it really... a dream...?

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: I wanted to meet you...

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Ah, ah... baby, my baby...

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Baby!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Der takes Genepe in his arms.)

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: I... I kept looking for my mom.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: I see, I'm sorry, I'm sorry...!

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: I kept looking... I kept looking.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Mom... Mom missed you too.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Yeah... it was long, it was too long...

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: Still, I saw a lot.

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: I helped a girl who looked like my mom.

lines.speaker: 게네페
lines.text: And, in a world without the devil, the sunlight is truly beautiful. Ah, there are so many stories to tell...!

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Yes, tell me, tell me everything. Mom will listen.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Let's stay with mom.

lines.speaker: 데르
lines.text: Now, we will never be separated again...!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The figures of Der and Genepe slowly disappear in the light.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (At first glance, it seems like the two people looked at each other and nodded.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (After hearing her tearful laughter, the two disappear completely.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Only Vanaheim, the forest of memories that Der dreamed of in loneliness, was left.)
